settings.why_en: QEMU has no real SMC/power-management. Do not turn this off.
settings.why_zh: QEMU 没有真实 SMC/电源管理，禁止关掉。

settings.why_en: Required for QEMU host-passthrough / Penryn topology. Replaced the old Algrey CPU patch. +invtsc is no longer required.
settings.why_zh: QEMU host-passthrough / Penryn 拓扑必需。取代旧的 Algrey CPU 补丁，不再强制 +invtsc。

settings.why_en: Needed so non-real-Mac SMBIOS can load Apple Secure Boot media.
settings.why_zh: 非真实 Mac 的 SMBIOS 要能加载 Apple Secure Boot 安装介质。

settings.why_en: TRIM during boot is extremely slow on virtual disks. 0 disables it.
settings.why_zh: 虚拟磁盘开机跑 TRIM 会极慢，0 表示关闭。

settings.why_en: Breaks boot on many QEMU/OVMF firmwares. Keep false.
settings.why_zh: 在不少 QEMU/OVMF 固件上会直接无法引导，必须保持 false。

settings.why_en: Hyper-V Gen2 32-bit only. Must stay false on KVM.
settings.why_zh: 只给 Hyper-V Gen2 的 32 位用，KVM 必须保持 false。

settings.why_en: Standard boot-stability quirk; required by ocvalidate-era Sample and QEMU.
settings.why_zh: 引导稳定性开关，QEMU 上保持开启。

settings.why_en: Needed together with ProvideCustomSlide.
settings.why_zh: 需要和 ProvideCustomSlide 一起开。

settings.why_en: OVMF memory protection; keep enabled.
settings.why_zh: OVMF 内存保护相关，保持开启。

settings.why_en: Required slide support on virtual firmware.
settings.why_zh: 虚拟固件上的 slide 支持，必须开。

settings.why_en: Lets OpenCore own Boot#### NVRAM on OVMF.
settings.why_zh: 让 OpenCore 接管 OVMF 的 Boot#### NVRAM。

settings.why_en: Required for FileVault / Apple firmware volume on OVMF.
settings.why_zh: OVMF 上 FileVault / Apple firmware volume 需要。

settings.why_en: OpenCanopy picker needs GOP on OVMF.
settings.why_zh: OVMF 上 OpenCanopy 图形菜单需要 GOP。

settings.why_en: A non-zero timeout can make the installer re-enter itself.
settings.why_zh: Timeout 非 0 时安装器可能反复进入自己。

settings.why_en: Keep the picker visible so a bad default entry is recoverable.
settings.why_zh: 保持选择菜单可见，避免默认项坏了无法恢复。

settings.why_en: Uses OpenCanopy. Do not switch to Builtin unless you drop OpenCanopy.efi.
settings.why_zh: 走 OpenCanopy。除非去掉 OpenCanopy.efi，不要改成 Builtin。

settings.why_en: QEMU SMBIOS is not a real Mac. Default/j137 will refuse to boot installers.
settings.why_zh: QEMU 的 SMBIOS 不是真机。Default/j137 会拒绝启动安装器。

settings.why_en: Sample.plist uses Secure. That bricks unsigned KVM images.
settings.why_zh: 官方 Sample 默认 Secure，会让未签名的 KVM 镜像无法启动。

settings.why_en: mkmaciso / macos-iso-builder installers wrap BaseSystem.dmg inside Install macOS *.app. Signed can hide those DMGs on OVMF when SecureBootModel is Disabled.
settings.why_zh: mkmaciso / macos-iso-builder 把 BaseSystem.dmg 包在 Install macOS *.app 里。OVMF 上 SecureBootModel=Disabled 时 Signed 可能把这些 DMG 藏掉。

settings.why_en: Needed to load newer Apple installer/recovery EFI images on OVMF.
settings.why_zh: OVMF 上加载较新的 Apple 安装器/恢复 EFI 需要打开。

settings.why_en: Some OVMF builds skip connecting filesystems on ATAPI/optical devices. Required to see mkmaciso hybrid installer CDs.
settings.why_zh: 部分 OVMF 不会给 ATAPI/光盘接文件系统。要认出 mkmaciso 混合安装光盘必须打开。

settings.why_en: PCI-passthrough NVMe shows up as a late device on OVMF. Full connect is required before APFS jumpstart can expose Macintosh HD.
settings.why_zh: PCI 直通的 NVMe 在 OVMF 上像后挂上的设备。APFS jumpstart 要先 GlobalConnect 才能露出 Macintosh HD。

settings.why_en: Re-run APFS jumpstart when NVMe/USB appears after the first connect pass.
settings.why_zh: NVMe/USB 在第一轮连接之后才出现时，补跑一次 APFS jumpstart。

settings.why_en: SMBIOS is generated from Generic. Do not switch to manual tables.
settings.why_zh: SMBIOS 由 Generic 生成，不要改成手写表。

settings.why_en: Default KVM SMBIOS for this image. Changing it needs a matching ROM/MLB/serial.
settings.why_zh: 本镜像默认 SMBIOS。改机型必须同步改 ROM/MLB/序列号。

settings.why_en: OVMF has no Apple SMBIOS to patch; Create is required.
settings.why_zh: OVMF 没有可补丁的 Apple SMBIOS，必须用 Create。

settings.why_en: Spoofs Penryn (0x00050654) so macOS accepts the virtual CPU.
settings.why_zh: 伪装 Penryn（0x00050654），让 macOS 接受这颗虚拟 CPU。

settings.why_en: Applies the Penryn family/model/stepping mask.
settings.why_zh: Penryn 的 family/model/stepping 掩码。

PciRoot(0x1)/Pci(0x1F,0x0).name: pci8086,2916
PciRoot(0x1)/Pci(0x1F,0x0).why_en: ICH9 LPC spoof used by Q35/ICH9 VMs.
PciRoot(0x1)/Pci(0x1F,0x0).why_zh: Q35/ICH9 虚拟机的 LPC 伪装。

kexts.why_en: iMacPro1,1 panics without this on many VMs.
kexts.why_zh: 很多虚拟机上 iMacPro1,1 没有它会 panic。

kexts.why_en: This image uses DummyPowerManagement instead of VirtualSMC.
kexts.why_zh: 本镜像用 DummyPowerManagement，不启用 VirtualSMC。

kexts.why_en: Non-AVX2 hosts cannot boot Ventura+ without it.
kexts.why_zh: 宿主机没有 AVX2 时，Ventura 及以上必须靠它。

kexts.why_en: Must NOT load on Monterey+. Wrong range caused 20-minute boots on v20.
kexts.why_zh: Monterey 及以上绝不能加载。范围写错会像 v20 那样开机 20 分钟。

kexts.why_en: Bluetooth for macOS 12+. Keep MinKernel at 21.0.0.
kexts.why_zh: macOS 12+ 的蓝牙。MinKernel 必须是 21.0.0。

Booter/Quirks/FixupAppleEfiImages.why_en: Upstream now defaults true to boot newer/broken Apple EFI images. Worth enabling for new macOS installers on KVM; test Recovery first.
Booter/Quirks/FixupAppleEfiImages.why_zh: 官方默认改为 true，用来引导较新或损坏的 Apple EFI 镜像。KVM 装新系统时值得打开，先测恢复分区。

UEFI/APFS/MinDate.why_en: Sample 0 filters APFS by date. Keep -1 so older guests and installers still mount.
UEFI/APFS/MinDate.why_zh: Sample 的 0 会按日期过滤 APFS。虚拟机要装老系统应保持 -1。

UEFI/APFS/MinVersion.why_en: Same as MinDate: 0 can hide older APFS volumes. Keep -1 on this image.
UEFI/APFS/MinVersion.why_zh: 和 MinDate 一样，0 可能藏掉旧 APFS 卷。本镜像保持 -1。

Misc/Boot/HibernateMode.why_en: VMs rarely hibernate. Sample None is reasonable; Auto is also safe. Only change after testing.
Misc/Boot/HibernateMode.why_zh: 虚拟机几乎不休眠。Sample 的 None 合理，Auto 也可以。改之前先测。

Misc/Security/ScanPolicy.why_en: Controls which disks OpenCore scans. Do not copy Sample blindly or VirtIO/USB/ATAPI installers may vanish. Keep 0 for mkmaciso UDF+HFS hybrids.
Misc/Security/ScanPolicy.why_zh: 决定扫描哪些磁盘。不要照抄 Sample，否则 VirtIO/USB/ATAPI 安装盘可能消失。mkmaciso 的 UDF+HFS 混合盘保持 0。

Misc/BlessOverride.why_en: OpenCore 1.0.7 extra bless paths (same scanner as System/Library/CoreServices/boot.efi). Keep .IABootFiles/boot.efi and Install macOS *.app SharedSupport BaseSystem.dmg. First existing path on a volume wins.
Misc/BlessOverride.why_zh: OpenCore 1.0.7 的额外 bless 路径（和 System/Library/CoreServices/boot.efi 同一套扫描）。保留 .IABootFiles/boot.efi 和 Install macOS *.app 里的 BaseSystem.dmg。每个卷上先命中的那条生效。

UEFI/Output/Resolution.why_en: Guest display preference, not a boot-critical quirk.
UEFI/Output/Resolution.why_zh: 客户机分辨率偏好，不是引导生死开关。
